Class JavaSourceGroup

java.lang.Object
uno.anahata.asi.nb.tools.project.components.ProjectNode
uno.anahata.asi.nb.tools.project.components.JavaSourceGroup
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class JavaSourceGroup extends ProjectNode
A specialized container for a Java source group (e.g., src/main/java).

This class performs a deep scan of the Java source root, resolving logical types into a hierarchical package-centric view. It performs a hybrid scan, merging logical type information from the index with a physical filesystem walk to ensure 'package-info.java' and other non-indexed files are included.

Author:
Anahata

    • JavaSourceGroup

      public JavaSourceGroup(org.netbeans.api.project.Project project, org.netbeans.api.project.SourceGroup sg, ProjectStructureScope scope, List<String> scanWarnings, ProjectStructure.ScanStrategy scanStrategy) throws Exception
      Constructs and populates the Java source group logic using direct filesystem traversal and fast metadata resolution.

      Implementation details: 1. Walks the physical source root directly, grouping source files into JavaPackages. 2. Resolves metadata (element kinds, supertypes, inner classes, and Javadocs) using the chosen strategy: - Fast ProjectStructure.ScanStrategy.ASM_SIG via OW2 ASM reading NetBeans index cache (.sig files). - Deep ProjectStructure.ScanStrategy.JAVASOURCE_AST via a single-pass JavaSource compiler task when Javadoc is enabled.

      Parameters:
      project - The parent project.
      sg - The NetBeans source group instance.
      scope - The active project structure granularity scope.
      scanWarnings - List to collect any resolution warnings.
      scanStrategy - The scan strategy to apply.
      Throws:
      Exception - if filesystem operations fail.

      Calculates the total recursive size of this node and all its descendants.

      Implementation details: This method must perform a deep traversal of the subtree rooted at this node, summing the sizes of all constituent physical files or logical components to provide an accurate total byte count for the branch.
